title: McDonald's Cosmic Gateway
description: A surreal cosmic scene features a giant golden McDonald's archway covered in glowing runes, with the restaurant visible in the background. In the foreground, a massive veined eyeball with a red iris emerges from cracked earth with roots, while two colorful cats (one orange, one white with purple markings) sit beside piles of McDonald's chicken nuggets and fries; an elderly robed man and a grey alien stand on the right under a swirling galaxy and planets.
prompt: Surreal cosmic scene with a giant glowing golden McDonald's arch covered in runes standing in the center, restaurant visible behind it. Massive detailed veined eyeball with red iris emerging from cracked fiery ground with roots on the left. Two stylized cats, one orange and one white with purple markings and green eyes, sitting in front of piles of chicken nuggets and french fries. An old man in robes and a grey alien standing on the right. Swirling galaxy, planets, and stars in the dramatic night sky, bizarre and mystical atmosphere.
